title: When the Debt Falls
author: Felix Blackwood
blurb: Ivo Villalobos, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
